title: KeyManagerVerificationFailedError

connectionId.description: A key-manager connection's id: a version 4 UUID the adding client mints, kept in lowercase.

reason.description: rejected: the key manager refused the credential. root_token: it signs in with the root policy, which the harness never holds.

details.description: What the key manager or the environment said behind the plain message, one line each, for Details: addresses, paths, HTTP statuses and system error codes. Absent when there is nothing more.

description: The key manager refused the credential, or it signs in as root, which the harness never holds: nothing was stored. data names the connection and the reason.
